summary.headline: Astrological Signs and Degrees
summary.text: Astrological chapter list covering masculine and feminine degrees; bright, dark, shadowy, light, fortunate, deceitful, and gloomy degrees; relationships among signs; decans and co-rising; climes, movable and immovable signs; bodily parts, human habits, beauty, freedom, wealth, questions, diseases, prudence, fertility, voice, illnesses, eyes, and passions. Authorities and references include Boll’s Sphaera and Catalogus volume IV.
